findings.problem: 18 keys insert ASCII spaces between Chinese and a placeholder or Latin run ('发送到 {device}：', '将发送 {count…} 个工作树', '游离 HEAD', '被 Git 忽略', '更新 Local Operator'). zh-CN.md: 'No space inserted between Chinese text and Latin/digit runs'; the existing ui.mesh values have 0 such spaces vs 109 unspaced placeholder joins (corpus-wide 138 vs 2379).
findings.fix: Drop the spaces: '发送到{device}：', '将发送{count, number, ::group-off}个工作树', '游离HEAD', '被Git忽略', '在该设备上更新Local Operator', '可用{command}重新创建'…

findings.problem: Single '…'; zh-CN.md requires the two-mark ellipsis '……' (ui.mesh already uses it in 10 of 11 values).
findings.fix: '正在检查此次移动会发送哪些工作文件……'

findings.problem: '已保留——不会发送' uses 保留, the same word as the neighbouring heading left_behind_heading '保留在原处' (and the corpus's usual sense 'kept'); the two section headings — secrets withheld vs dependencies left in place — become hard to tell apart.

findings.note: Mechanical checks on the committed bytes at dd014c1e9d (scratch script run with the repo's @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser): key set equals English; the base..head diff of this file is exactly the 42 added working_set_* lines (0 changed, 0 removed values, so every other value is the bytes audited by the superseded row); every audited value parses and carries the same arguments, types and ::group-off skeletons as English; plural arms present for every CLDR category of the locale and no foreign arm; NFC; no bidi controls (U+200E/F, U+202A-E, U+2066-9, U+061C); no ASCII '...'; no leading/trailing/double spaces; no <Trans> tags in this namespace.
